run.change_description: lib/batcher: prevent commits racing shutdown - fixes #9687

summary.intent: Serialize Commit admission with insertion of the shutdown quit marker so every accepted request is processed or rejected with the existing shutdown error (fixes #9687).
summary.issue_fit: Full — admission and the quit marker now share one critical section, so no request can queue behind the marker; the shutdown error is unchanged.
summary.coverage: Both changed files fully reviewed with the dropbox and googlephotos callers; the new test passes at head and fails at the merge-base. Uncommitted clone files (.mcp.json, .claude/) are outside the range and were not reviewed.
check_details: Reviewer ran `go test -count=1 -race -v ./lib/batcher` at the reviewed head: all pass, including TestBatcherCommitRacingShutdown/sync and /async.

Reviewer ran `go test -count=5 -race -run TestBatcherCommitRacingShutdown ./lib/batcher` with the merge-base batcher.go overlaid: 5 of 5 runs fail for both modes (hang and dropped commit), so the test detects the defect.
The PR's claimed `-count=20`, `go vet`, `go build` and `make quicktest` were not re-run; no CI evidence was supplied, and none of them decides a candidate.

observations.fact: Commit now holds the admission mutex across its send on b.in, so concurrent Commits queue on the mutex rather than on the channel when b.in is full; the commit loop keeps draining, so this only delays them.
The regression test relies on a 100ms wait to let Shutdown contend for the held mutex, and mutates the global log level to reach the blocking Stringer; both are deterministic in outcome at head.

requirements.evidence: lib/batcher/batcher.go:243-252 and :267-281 put the closed check plus send and the close plus quit send under admitMu; verifier ruled premise batcher/no-request-behind-quit holds.

No request can queue behind the quit marker, so sync callers cannot block forever and async uploads are not dropped; verified by TestBatcherCommitRacingShutdown failing at the merge-base and passing at head.
lib/batcher/batcher.go:269-271 returns the unchanged fserrors.FatalError("batcher is shutting down") for Commits that see b.closed.
lib/batcher/batcher_test.go:239-311 covers sync (commitDone hang) and async (committed never closed); base overlay run failed 5/5.
Only `go test -count=1 -race ./lib/batcher` was re-run (pass); -count=20, go vet, go build and make quicktest were not (offline policy, packages outside lib/batcher need uncached modules).

tasks.premise: No request can be placed on b.in behind the quit marker: both send sites run under admitMu, Shutdown closes b.closed before sending quit in one critical section, and Commit checks b.closed in the same critical section as its send.

admitMu introduces no deadlock: the commit loop drains b.in until the quit marker, b.wg.Wait and the response wait run after Unlock, and the dropbox and googlephotos commit callbacks never call Commit or Shutdown.
